title: One classifier, two matrix products
summary: Build a Dense–ReLU–Dense classifier and follow its inputs, logits, loss and saved weights.

steps.title: Preserve the split
steps.body: Run the bundled preparation. Fit mean and scale on training rows; transform held-out rows with that same state. The backend consumes those pinned ports without splitting again. Inspect the actual counts in the completed run.

steps.title: Follow the dimensions
steps.body: For a batch of B rows, X has shape [B,2]. The first Keras kernel has shape [2,8] and bias [8]. H = ReLU(XK₁ + b₁), shape [B,8]. Logits Z = HK₂ + b₂, shape [B,2].

steps.title: Count the trainable values
steps.body: First Dense: 2×8 + 8 = 24 values. Second Dense: 8×2 + 2 = 18 values. Total: 42. Keras stores the kernel as [input, output]; PyTorch Linear stores its weight as [output, input]. Transpose when translating weights.

steps.title: Interpret the objective
steps.body: Sparse cross-entropy receives integer class labels and raw logits. Stable log-sum-exp converts the two logits to the log probability of the correct class. Do not add a softmax just to suppress large values; examine loss, inputs, gradients and learning rate first.

steps.title: Run a controlled comparison
steps.body: Keep the preparation manifest fixed. Change only the initialization seed or learning rate. Compare held-out loss and accuracy; training improvement alone does not demonstrate generalization. Repeatedly tuning on validation can overfit that validation set.

steps.title: Reuse the result
steps.body: The export has portable inference code, a graph and Keras HDF5 weights. Its inference expects already prepared float32 rows of width 2. The run separately archives the exact preparation and provenance. Weight reload is inference restoration; optimizer-state continuation is not implemented.

checks.question: What is the hidden tensor shape for 16 rows?
How many parameters remain if both biases are disabled?
May the held-out rows determine the scaler mean?
checks.expected: No; that leaks held-out information into training.

limitations: Reading and manual checks; no automatically scored assessment receipt. CPU only. GPU, optimizer resume, arbitrary layers and custom code remain unsupported.
